name: How do I choose the right contractor for my room addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for an experienced general contractor who provides hands-on jobsite supervision, holds active business accreditation, and offers transparent communication. Many homeowners prefer owner-operated firms where the business owner acts as the primary contact and works directly on-site rather than delegating entirely to rotating sales representatives. Check verified customer reviews and past project examples. HH Remodeling maintains an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau, providing reliable oversight across Aurora, Parker, Centennial, and greater Denver.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a licensed, BBB-accredited contractor who provides hands-on on-site supervision, clear communication, and transparent trade coordination.
